title: Nourishing Light Argentinian Chicken Empanadas
description: A delicate and flavorful Argentinian dish featuring tender chicken, a hint of HP sauce, and a touch of sweetness.
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine flour, salt, and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, milk, granulated sugar, and HP sauce.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Brush the edges with beaten egg and place a tablespoon of shredded chicken in the center.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges to seal.
Use a fork to crimp the edges.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush with vegetable oil.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve warm with confectioners' sugar and candy pieces (if using).
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
